Optional order inside a stage (PFM 2026-11-11, 2A); everyone in a stage coordinates at the same time (DAFMAN 3.4)

DAFMAN 90-161 Table A3.1 items 1, 3, 4, 5 (servicing legal office; records, privacy, FOIA, information collections; reserve and ANG applicability), 1.5.3 (FOIA review), Table A3.2 and 5.1 (functional and other offices); PFM 2026-11-11 (r7, design check decision 1A)
fields.description: Who the office coordinates for. Legal, Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), Privacy, Records and Information Collections come from Table A3.1 item 3 and item 1; Guard and Reserve Applicability from items 4 and 5; Higher Headquarters OPR is the office of primary responsibility (OPR) of the higher headquarters publication; Functional from Table A3.2.
